project.name: psi-fatture-sa
project.description: A desktop invoice management application for psychologists (psicologi), built with Tauri 2, Vue 3, and SQLite. Automates the full invoicing lifecycle including Italian tax calculations (ENPAP, ritenuta, marca da bollo), appointment tracking, client management, and monthly batch invoicing.

nodes.name: build.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri build script that invokes tauri_build::build() to generate the platform-specific glue code required by the Tauri framework at compile time.

nodes.name: mod.rs (controller)
nodes.summary: Module declaration file that re-exports all six controller sub-modules, making the controller layer accessible as a unified public API surface.

nodes.name: appointment_controller.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers for appointment management, exposing six async commands (list, get, create, create_recurring, update, delete) that delegate directly to appointment_service.

nodes.name: client_controller.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers for client CRUD operations, providing five async commands (list, get, create, update, delete) that delegate to client_service.

nodes.name: config_controller.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers for the singleton professional configuration, exposing get and upsert commands that delegate to config_service.

nodes.name: dashboard_controller.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handler that exposes a single get_dashboard command returning aggregated annual analytics by delegating to dashboard_service.

nodes.name: invoice_controller.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers for invoice management, covering nine commands including CRUD, next-number generation, monthly preview, bulk status update, and batch invoice generation, all delegating to invoice_service.

nodes.name: service_controller.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers for billable service CRUD operations, providing five async commands (list, get, create, update, delete) that delegate to service_service.

nodes.name: list_appointments
nodes.summary: Exported Tauri command that lists appointments with optional date range and client filters by delegating to appointment_service::list.

nodes.name: get_appointment
nodes.summary: Exported Tauri command that retrieves a single appointment by ID via appointment_service::get.

nodes.name: create_appointment
nodes.summary: Exported Tauri command that creates a single appointment from a CreateAppointmentInput and returns the persisted record.

nodes.name: create_recurring_appointments
nodes.summary: Exported Tauri command that creates multiple recurring appointments in a transaction from a CreateRecurringAppointmentsInput.

nodes.name: update_appointment
nodes.summary: Exported Tauri command that updates an existing appointment via appointment_service::update and returns the updated record.

nodes.name: delete_appointment
nodes.summary: Exported Tauri command that deletes an appointment by ID via appointment_service::remove.

nodes.name: list_clients
nodes.summary: Exported Tauri command that lists all clients with an optional search string filter via client_service::list.

nodes.name: create_client
nodes.summary: Exported Tauri command that creates a new client from a CreateClientInput and returns the persisted record.

nodes.name: update_client
nodes.summary: Exported Tauri command that updates an existing client via client_service::update.

nodes.name: get_config
nodes.summary: Exported Tauri command that retrieves the singleton professional config, returning None if not yet set.

nodes.name: upsert_config
nodes.summary: Exported Tauri command that inserts or updates the singleton professional config (id=1) and returns the saved record.

nodes.name: get_dashboard
nodes.summary: Exported Tauri command that returns aggregated DashboardData analytics for a given year via dashboard_service::get.

nodes.name: list_invoices
nodes.summary: Exported Tauri command that lists invoices using an InvoiceFilters struct (year, status, client_id, search) via invoice_service::list.

nodes.name: create_invoice
nodes.summary: Exported Tauri command that creates a new invoice in a transaction from CreateInvoiceInput and returns it.

nodes.name: update_invoice
nodes.summary: Exported Tauri command that updates an invoice in a transaction from UpdateInvoiceInput and returns the updated record.

nodes.name: get_next_invoice_number
nodes.summary: Exported Tauri command that computes and returns the next invoice number string for a given year.

nodes.name: preview_monthly_invoices
nodes.summary: Exported Tauri command that returns a preview list of invoices that would be generated for a given year/month without persisting them.

nodes.name: bulk_update_invoice_status
nodes.summary: Exported Tauri command that updates the status of multiple invoices at once via a BulkUpdateStatusInput and returns the affected row count.

nodes.name: generate_monthly_invoices
nodes.summary: Exported Tauri command that generates and persists invoices from completed appointments for selected clients using GenerateMonthlyInput.

nodes.name: list_services
nodes.summary: Exported Tauri command that lists billable services with an optional active_only boolean filter.

nodes.name: create_service
nodes.summary: Exported Tauri command that creates a new billable service from CreateServiceInput and returns it.

nodes.name: update_service
nodes.summary: Exported Tauri command that updates an existing billable service via service_service::update.

nodes.name: connection.rs
nodes.summary: Manages SQLite database initialization via SeaORM: resolves the platform-specific DB file path and opens a connection pool with WAL mode and foreign key enforcement, then runs all pending migrations before returning the connection handle.

nodes.name: db_path
nodes.summary: Resolves the platform-local data directory, creates the 'psi-fatture-sa' subdirectory if absent, and returns the full path to 'database.db'.

nodes.name: init_db
nodes.summary: Async function that opens the SeaORM SQLite connection pool with WAL journal mode and foreign key support enabled, then applies all pending SeaORM migrations before returning the live DatabaseConnection.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel file for the db package; re-exports the 'connection' submodule publicly so callers can access db::connection::init_db.

nodes.name: appointment.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity mapping to the 'appointments' SQLite table; defines the Model struct with scheduling fields and three foreign-key relations to client, service, and recurrence_group entities.

nodes.name: Model
nodes.summary: Struct representing a single appointment row: holds client_id, service_id, date/time fields, status, notes, recurrence_group_id, and invoice_id as nullable foreign keys.

nodes.name: Relation
nodes.summary: Enum declaring the three SeaORM foreign-key relations for Appointment: belongs_to Client, belongs_to Service, and belongs_to RecurrenceGroup.

nodes.name: client.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity mapping to the 'clients' SQLite table; defines personal/fiscal identity fields for psychotherapy patients and declares has_many relations to invoices and appointments.

nodes.name: Model
nodes.summary: Struct holding all client data: identity (first/last name, fiscal code, VAT number), contact details, address, STS authorization flag, and audit timestamps.

nodes.name: Relation
nodes.summary: Enum declaring the two SeaORM has_many relations for Client: Invoices and Appointments.

nodes.name: invoice.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity mapping to the 'invoices' SQLite table; captures the full financial lifecycle of an invoice including Italian tax fields (ENPAP, ritenuta, marca da bollo) and totals, with relations to client and invoice_lines.

nodes.name: Model
nodes.summary: Struct representing an invoice row: invoice number, year, dates, status, payment method, Italian-specific tax fields (ENPAP contribution, withholding tax, stamp duty), and pre-computed net/tax/gross/due totals.

nodes.name: Relation
nodes.summary: Enum declaring Invoice relations: belongs_to Client and has_many InvoiceLines.

nodes.name: invoice_line.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity mapping to the 'invoice_lines' SQLite table; represents a single line item on an invoice with quantity, unit price, VAT rate, and a pre-computed line total.

nodes.name: Model
nodes.summary: Struct for a single invoice line: links to an invoice and optionally a service, storing description, quantity, unit price, VAT rate, and the computed line_total.

nodes.name: Relation
nodes.summary: Enum declaring the single belongs_to Invoice relation for an invoice line.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel that publicly re-exports all seven SeaORM entity submodules (appointment, client, invoice, invoice_line, professional_config, recurrence_group, service), providing a single import path for the entire entity layer.

nodes.name: professional_config.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity mapping to the 'professional_config' singleton table; stores the psychologist's full professional identity including fiscal details, ENPAP-related coefficient, and invoice sequencing seed.

nodes.name: Model
nodes.summary: Struct with a non-auto-increment primary key holding the professional's title, name, VAT/fiscal codes, tax regime, albo registration, address, contact info, IBAN, ENPAP coefficient, and initial invoice number.

nodes.name: Relation
nodes.summary: Empty Relation enum indicating ProfessionalConfig has no foreign-key associations to other entities.

nodes.name: recurrence_group.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity mapping to 'recurrence_groups'; a lightweight aggregate root that groups a set of recurring appointments for a specific client, enabling batch operations on repeating sessions.

nodes.name: Model
nodes.summary: Minimal struct holding only id, client_id, and created_at — acts as a grouping handle for recurring appointment sets.

nodes.name: Relation
nodes.summary: Enum declaring RecurrenceGroup relations: belongs_to Client and has_many Appointments.

nodes.name: entity/service.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity definition for the 'services' database table. Declares the Model struct mapping to all service columns (name, description, default_price, vat_rate, is_active, timestamps), an empty Relation enum, and a no-op ActiveModelBehavior impl.

nodes.name: Model
nodes.summary: SeaORM entity model for a professional service (therapy session type). Maps the 'services' table with fields: id, name, description, default_price, vat_rate, is_active (i32), created_at, updated_at.

nodes.name: Relation
nodes.summary: Empty SeaORM Relation enum for the service entity, indicating no foreign-key relations are declared at the ORM level.

nodes.name: app/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel file that re-exports all six sub-modules of the app layer: controller, db, entity, model, repository, and service. Acts as the single entry point for the entire application module tree.

nodes.name: model/appointment.rs
nodes.summary: DTO module for appointment-related Tauri command boundaries. Defines the read DTO (Appointment), create/update input structs, a recurring creation input, and the AppointmentStatus enum with string conversion helpers.

nodes.name: Appointment
nodes.summary: Read DTO for an appointment returned from Tauri commands. Includes client and service references (by id and denormalized name), scheduling fields, status, recurrence group link, and optional invoice linkage.

nodes.name: CreateAppointmentInput
nodes.summary: Input DTO for creating a single appointment via Tauri command. Carries client_id, optional service_id, date/time range, status, notes, and optional recurrence_group_id.

nodes.name: UpdateAppointmentInput
nodes.summary: Input DTO for updating an existing appointment. Same fields as create but adds the appointment id for targeting the record.

nodes.name: CreateRecurringAppointmentsInput
nodes.summary: Input DTO for bulk-creating recurring appointments across multiple dates. Carries a Vec<String> of dates and a shared time range, client, and optional service.

nodes.name: AppointmentStatus
nodes.summary: Enum representing appointment lifecycle states: Scheduled, Completed, Cancelled. Implements as_str() and From<String> for serialization and DB round-tripping.

nodes.name: model/client.rs
nodes.summary: DTO module for client-related Tauri commands. Defines the Client read DTO, CreateClientInput, UpdateClientInput, and the ClientType enum (PersonaFisica / Azienda) with Italian-locale serialization.

nodes.name: Client
nodes.summary: Read DTO for a psychologist's patient/client. Holds full personal and fiscal data including fiscal_code, optional vat_number, address fields, STS authorization flag, and audit timestamps.

nodes.name: CreateClientInput
nodes.summary: Input DTO for creating a new client. Contains all mutable fields of Client except the system-managed id and timestamps.

nodes.name: UpdateClientInput
nodes.summary: Input DTO for updating an existing client. Identical to CreateClientInput but includes the client id for record targeting.

nodes.name: ClientType
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing client classification: PersonaFisica (individual) or Azienda (company). Serialized with snake_case; implements as_str() and From<String> for DB persistence.

nodes.name: model/config.rs
nodes.summary: DTO module for professional configuration. Defines ProfessionalConfig (read DTO), UpsertConfigInput (create/update), and the TaxRegime enum (Forfettario / Ordinario) for Italian tax regime selection.

nodes.name: ProfessionalConfig
nodes.summary: Read DTO for the psychologist's professional configuration. Holds identity fields (title, name, VAT/fiscal codes), albo registration, address, contact info, IBAN, tax coefficient, psicoanalista flag, and initial invoice numbering.

nodes.name: UpsertConfigInput
nodes.summary: Input DTO for creating or updating the professional configuration. Mirrors all ProfessionalConfig fields except id and timestamps.

nodes.name: TaxRegime
nodes.summary: Enum representing the Italian tax regime of the psychologist: Forfettario (flat-rate) or Ordinario (standard). Implements as_str() and From<String> for serialization.

nodes.name: model/dashboard.rs
nodes.summary: DTO module for the dashboard summary view. Defines DashboardData (aggregated revenue/invoice KPIs plus recent invoices) and MonthlyRevenue (per-month revenue breakdown). Depends on the Invoice DTO.

nodes.name: DashboardData
nodes.summary: Read DTO for the dashboard summary. Carries annual revenue aggregates (total, net, paid, unpaid), invoice counts by status, a monthly breakdown Vec, and a list of recent Invoice DTOs.

nodes.name: MonthlyRevenue
nodes.summary: Read DTO for a single month's revenue summary. Holds month index, localized month name, total revenue, and invoice count for that month.

nodes.name: model/invoice.rs
nodes.summary: Core DTO module for invoice operations. Defines the Invoice read DTO, InvoiceLine, create/update input structs, InvoiceLineInput, enums for InvoiceStatus and PaymentMethod (with Italian payment labels), plus batch-invoicing DTOs: MonthlyInvoicePreview, GenerateMonthlyInput, BulkUpdateStatusInput, and InvoiceFilters.

nodes.name: Invoice
nodes.summary: Primary read DTO for an invoice. Contains client reference, invoice number, fiscal year, dates, status, payment method, Italian-specific tax fields (ENPAP contribution, ritenuta d'acconto, marca da bollo), computed totals, and embedded invoice lines.

nodes.name: InvoiceLine
nodes.summary: Read DTO for a single invoice line. Holds optional service reference, description, quantity, unit price, VAT rate, and computed line total.

nodes.name: CreateInvoiceInput
nodes.summary: Input DTO for creating a new invoice via Tauri command. Captures client, dates, status, payment method, ENPAP flag, and embedded line inputs.

nodes.name: UpdateInvoiceInput
nodes.summary: Input DTO for updating an existing invoice. Extends CreateInvoiceInput with the invoice id and an optional paid_date for recording settlement.

nodes.name: InvoiceLineInput
nodes.summary: Input DTO for an individual invoice line used in both create and update operations. Carries optional service_id, description, quantity, unit price, and VAT rate.

nodes.name: InvoiceStatus
nodes.summary: Enum for invoice lifecycle: Draft, Issued, Paid, Overdue, Cancelled. Implements as_str() and From<String> for serde and DB interop.

nodes.name: PaymentMethod
nodes.summary: Enum for Italian payment methods: Bonifico (bank transfer), Contanti (cash), Pos (card), Altro (other). Implements as_str() and From<String>.

nodes.name: MonthlyInvoicePreview
nodes.summary: DTO for previewing a batch monthly invoice for one client before generation. Holds appointment count, pre-computed lines, and estimated net/due totals.

nodes.name: GenerateMonthlyInput
nodes.summary: Input DTO for triggering monthly batch invoice generation. Specifies the target year/month, a list of client IDs to invoice, payment method, and ENPAP flag.

nodes.name: BulkUpdateStatusInput
nodes.summary: Input DTO for bulk-updating the status of multiple invoices in one command. Carries a Vec of invoice IDs, the target InvoiceStatus, and optional paid_date.

nodes.name: InvoiceFilters
nodes.summary: DTO for filtering invoice list queries. Supports optional filtering by year, status string, client_id, and free-text search.

nodes.name: model/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel file for the model sub-module. Re-exports the six DTO sub-modules: appointment, client, config, dashboard, invoice, service.

nodes.name: model/service.rs
nodes.summary: DTO module for professional service operations. Defines Service (read DTO), CreateServiceInput, and UpdateServiceInput, mirroring the entity/service.rs schema but using bool for is_active instead of i32.

nodes.name: Service
nodes.summary: Read DTO for a professional service (therapy type). Maps name, description, default_price, vat_rate, is_active (bool), and timestamps.

nodes.name: CreateServiceInput
nodes.summary: Input DTO for creating a new professional service. Contains all editable fields except id and timestamps.

nodes.name: UpdateServiceInput
nodes.summary: Input DTO for updating an existing service. Mirrors CreateServiceInput but includes the service id.

nodes.name: appointment_repository.rs
nodes.summary: Implements all database access operations for appointments using SeaORM and raw SQL joins. Provides CRUD, recurrence group creation, unbilled appointment queries, and bulk invoice-linking via mark_as_invoiced.

nodes.name: client_repository.rs
nodes.summary: Implements SeaORM-based CRUD for client records with optional search filtering and an invoice-existence guard before deletion.

nodes.name: config_repository.rs
nodes.summary: Provides a singleton find and upsert-save for the professional_config entity using SeaORM.

nodes.name: invoice_repository.rs
nodes.summary: Implements all database operations for invoices and invoice lines, including filtered ID queries, full invoice hydration, next invoice number computation, tax regime lookup, and bulk status updates.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module that re-exports all repository sub-modules for the repository layer.

nodes.name: service_repository.rs
nodes.summary: Implements SeaORM-based CRUD for service records with optional active-only filtering.

nodes.name: appointment_service.rs
nodes.summary: Application service orchestrating appointment use cases: listing, get, single create, recurring batch create (in a DB transaction), update, and removal. Delegates all persistence to appointment_repository.

nodes.name: client_service.rs
nodes.summary: Application service orchestrating client use cases with domain model mapping; enforces the business rule that clients with associated invoices cannot be deleted.

nodes.name: config_service.rs
nodes.summary: Application service for professional configuration: retrieves the singleton config and performs upsert, mapping between entity and domain models.

nodes.name: find_all
nodes.summary: Queries appointments with optional date-range and client_id filters via a raw SQL JOIN, delegating row mapping to load_appointments_by_sql.

nodes.name: find_by_id
nodes.summary: Fetches a single appointment by id via raw SQL JOIN and returns an error if not found.

nodes.name: find_unbilled_for_month
nodes.summary: Returns completed appointments for a given year/month that have no invoice_id, used to drive batch invoicing.

nodes.name: mark_as_invoiced
nodes.summary: Bulk-updates the invoice_id field on a set of appointment rows in a single SQL statement.

nodes.name: insert_recurrence_group
nodes.summary: Inserts a new recurrence_group record for a client and returns its generated id.

nodes.name: find_all
nodes.summary: Returns all clients ordered by last/first name with optional multi-field search filter using SeaORM query builder.

nodes.name: has_invoices
nodes.summary: Checks whether a client has any associated invoice records; used to guard deletion.

nodes.name: find_ids
nodes.summary: Returns invoice IDs matching composite filters (year, status, client, search text) via raw SQL JOIN on clients.

nodes.name: load_invoice
nodes.summary: Fully hydrates an Invoice domain model by id, joining client name and loading all invoice lines.

nodes.name: insert_lines
nodes.summary: Inserts invoice line items for an invoice, computing line_net and line_total with rounding.

nodes.name: next_invoice_number
nodes.summary: Computes the next sequential invoice number for a year, respecting the initial_invoice_number floor from config.

nodes.name: bulk_update_status
nodes.summary: Updates status, paid_date, and updated_at for multiple invoices in a single parameterized SQL statement.

nodes.name: list
nodes.summary: Delegates appointment listing with optional date-range and client filters to the repository.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Builds an appointment ActiveModel from input, inserts it, and returns the fully-loaded record.

nodes.name: create_recurring
nodes.summary: Creates a recurrence group and inserts multiple appointments within a database transaction, returning all created records.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Builds an updated appointment ActiveModel and persists it, returning the refreshed record.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Maps CreateClientInput into a SeaORM ActiveModel, inserts it, and returns the domain Client.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Maps UpdateClientInput into a SeaORM ActiveModel with updated_at, persists it, and returns the domain Client.

nodes.name: remove
nodes.summary: Guards client deletion by checking for associated invoices before delegating to the repository.

nodes.name: upsert
nodes.summary: Builds a professional_config ActiveModel from input and delegates the upsert to config_repository, returning the domain model.

nodes.name: dashboard_service.rs
nodes.summary: Provides aggregated analytics for the dashboard, querying invoice statistics by year (revenue, counts, monthly breakdown) using raw SQL against SQLite. Exposes a single public async `get` function backed by private query helpers.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Returns aggregated DashboardData for a given year including total/paid/unpaid revenue, invoice counts, monthly revenue breakdown, and the 5 most recent invoices.

nodes.name: invoice_service.rs
nodes.summary: The most complex service (353 lines) — handles the full invoice lifecycle: CRUD operations, transactional creation/update, batch invoice generation from unbilled appointments, monthly preview, and bulk status updates. Delegates tax computation to tax_service.

nodes.name: list
nodes.summary: Lists invoices matching optional filters (year, status, client_id, search) by fetching IDs then loading each full invoice record.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Returns a single invoice with its lines by delegating to the invoice repository.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Creates a new invoice in a DB transaction: extracts year, assigns sequential invoice number, computes tax totals, inserts the invoice header and lines, then commits.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Updates an invoice in a DB transaction: recomputes tax totals, replaces all invoice lines, then commits and reloads the updated record.

nodes.name: remove
nodes.summary: Deletes an invoice by id via the invoice repository.

nodes.name: next_number
nodes.summary: Returns the next sequential invoice number string for the given year.

nodes.name: preview_monthly
nodes.summary: Generates a preview of invoices that would be created for a given month by grouping unbilled completed appointments by client and estimating totals without persisting anything.

nodes.name: generate_monthly
nodes.summary: Generates and persists invoices for selected clients from their unbilled monthly appointments, marking appointments as invoiced after successful creation.

nodes.name: bulk_update_status
nodes.summary: Updates the status of multiple invoices at once, setting paid_date when status is 'paid' and clearing it otherwise.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module that publicly re-exports all service submodules (appointment, client, config, dashboard, invoice, service, tax).

nodes.name: service_service.rs
nodes.summary: Manages the professional service catalog (therapy session types): provides CRUD operations (list, get, create, update, remove) and maps ORM entities to domain Service models.

nodes.name: list
nodes.summary: Lists all services, optionally filtered to active-only, mapped to domain Service objects.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Returns a single service by id or an error if not found.

nodes.name: create
nodes.summary: Creates a new service catalog entry and returns the domain Service model.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Updates an existing service entry by id and returns the updated domain model.

nodes.name: remove
nodes.summary: Deletes a service by id via the service repository.

nodes.name: tax_service.rs
nodes.summary: Pure Italian tax calculation module with no I/O: handles ENPAP contribution, ritenuta d'acconto, marca da bollo for per-invoice totals, and annual tax estimation for both forfettario and ordinario regimes including IRPEF bracket calculation.

nodes.name: calculate_invoice_totals
nodes.summary: Computes all invoice monetary totals from line items: net, VAT, ENPAP contribution, ritenuta d'acconto, marca da bollo, gross, and total due.

nodes.name: calculate_forfettario_tax
nodes.summary: Estimates annual taxes for the forfettario flat-rate regime, applying a profitability coefficient, INPS Gestione Separata, and a 5% or 15% substitute tax.

nodes.name: calculate_ordinario_tax
nodes.summary: Estimates annual taxes for the ordinario regime: deducts costs, computes INPS, applies progressive IRPEF brackets plus regional and municipal surcharges.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri application bootstrap: defines AppState with the DatabaseConnection, initializes the SQLite DB, registers all Tauri plugins (opener, dialog, fs), and wires every Tauri command handler from all controllers.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Initializes the database synchronously, constructs the Tauri application with managed state, registers all command handlers and plugins, and starts the event loop.

nodes.name: main.rs
nodes.summary: Minimal OS entry point that suppresses the Windows console subsystem in release builds and delegates immediately to lib.rs via `psi_fatture_sa_lib::run()`.

nodes.name: m20240101_create_schema.rs
nodes.summary: Initial SeaORM migration that creates the complete SQLite schema: professional_config, clients, services, invoices, invoice_lines, recurrence_groups, and appointments tables with all indexes.

nodes.name: m20240201_add_batch_invoicing.rs
nodes.summary: SeaORM migration that adds batch invoicing support: adds `initial_invoice_number` to professional_config and `invoice_id` foreign key to appointments with an index.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module for database migrations that implements SeaORM's MigratorTrait, registering all migration steps in execution order. It wires together the schema-creation and batch-invoicing migrations into the single Migrator struct consumed by the Tauri setup.

nodes.name: App.vue
nodes.summary: Root Vue component that renders nothing but a <RouterView />, delegating all layout and page rendering to the router. It is the minimal application shell mounted by main.ts.

nodes.name: api.ts
nodes.summary: Thin typed wrapper around Tauri's invoke() that exposes all Rust backend commands (config, clients, services, invoices, appointments, dashboard) as named async functions. It is the single frontend integration point for IPC communication with the Rust backend.

nodes.name: ConfirmModal.vue
nodes.summary: Reusable confirmation dialog component supporting 'danger' (destructive, red) and 'primary' (neutral, ocean) variants via computed CSS classes. Emits confirm/cancel events and renders via Teleport to the document body.

nodes.name: PageHeader.vue
nodes.summary: Minimal reusable page header component that renders a title, an optional subtitle, and a slot for action buttons. Used consistently at the top of every view page.

nodes.name: StatusBadge.vue
nodes.summary: Reusable status badge component that maps invoice and appointment status strings to localized Italian labels and Tailwind CSS classes. Supports two domain types: 'invoice' and 'appointment'.

nodes.name: main.ts
nodes.summary: Application entry point that bootstraps the Vue app by creating the Pinia store, registering the router, and mounting the root App component onto the DOM. Contains no business logic.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Vue Router configuration defining all application routes (Dashboard, Clients, Invoices, Agenda, Settings, Onboarding, Print) with lazy-loaded components and a global beforeEach guard that redirects unconfigured users to the onboarding flow.

nodes.name: clients.ts
nodes.summary: Pinia store for managing the clients collection, exposing reactive state (clients list, loading, error) and async actions (fetchClients, addClient, editClient, removeClient) that delegate to api.ts functions. Keeps local state in sync after each mutation.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Pinia store for professional configuration state, providing computed properties isConfigured and fullName derived from the ProfessionalConfig entity, and async actions to load and save config via api.ts.

nodes.name: invoices.ts
nodes.summary: Pinia store managing invoice list state, providing async CRUD operations and bulk status update via the api layer. Exposes reactive invoices, loading, and error refs alongside seven action functions.

nodes.name: services.ts
nodes.summary: Pinia store managing professional service definitions (CRUD), backed by api.ts calls. Maintains a reactive services list with loading and error state.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Central TypeScript type file that mirrors all Rust domain models, exporting 28 interfaces and type aliases covering clients, invoices, appointments, services, config, and dashboard data. Serves as the single source of truth for shared domain types across the frontend.

nodes.name: format.ts
nodes.summary: Utility module providing three pure formatting functions for Italian locale: currency (EUR), short date (dd/MM/yyyy), and long date (dd mese yyyy). Has no dependencies on other project files.

nodes.name: tax.ts
nodes.summary: Client-side implementation of Italian psychologist tax calculations, mirroring the Rust tax_service. Exports functions for invoice totals (ENPAP, ritenuta, marca da bollo) and annual tax estimates for both forfettario and ordinario regimes, including progressive IRPEF brackets.

nodes.name: DashboardView.vue
nodes.summary: Dashboard view displaying yearly KPI cards, a monthly revenue bar chart, and a tax estimate panel (forfettario or ordinario). Fetches DashboardData via api and integrates tax utility functions and config store to compute net income estimates.

nodes.name: OnboardingView.vue
nodes.summary: First-run onboarding view that collects all professional profile fields (personal info, tax regime, albo, address, contacts) and persists them via configStore. Redirects to dashboard on success.

nodes.name: SettingsView.vue
nodes.summary: Settings view allowing the professional to edit their full profile configuration. Pre-populates the form from configStore on mount and shows save confirmation feedback on success.

nodes.name: AgendaView.vue
nodes.summary: Calendar/agenda view rendering a monthly grid with appointment pills, a day-detail panel, and an appointment creation/edit modal. Reacts to month navigation changes via watchers and loads appointments from the API per visible month.

nodes.name: useInvoicesStore
nodes.summary: Pinia composable store exposing invoice CRUD actions (fetch, add, edit, remove), bulk status update, and next invoice number retrieval with reactive state refs.

nodes.name: useServicesStore
nodes.summary: Pinia composable store providing CRUD operations for professional service entities with reactive state tracking.

nodes.name: calculateInvoiceTotals
nodes.summary: Computes all invoice monetary totals including net, tax, ENPAP contribution, ritenuta d'acconto, marca da bollo, gross, and total due based on tax regime and line items.

nodes.name: estimateForfettarioTax
nodes.summary: Estimates annual forfettario tax liability including INPS contribution and flat-rate substitute tax (5% or 15%), returning a full breakdown of taxable income and net income.

nodes.name: estimateOrdinarioTax
nodes.summary: Estimates annual ordinario tax liability including INPS, progressive IRPEF, regional and municipal surcharges, returning a full breakdown of taxable income and net income.

nodes.name: DashboardView (setup)
nodes.summary: Vue Composition API setup for the dashboard: manages year selection, fetches dashboard data, computes bar chart heights, tax regime detection, and live tax estimate with net income percentage.

nodes.name: AgendaView (setup)
nodes.summary: Vue Composition API setup for the agenda: builds a Monday-first calendar grid, groups appointments by date, handles month navigation with reactive watchers, and manages modal state for create/edit operations.

nodes.name: AppointmentModal.vue
nodes.summary: Modal component for creating and editing appointments, supporting one-off and recurring appointment scheduling with day-of-week selection. Integrates client and service selection, delegates persistence to the API, and emits save/delete events to the parent view.

nodes.name: ClientFormView.vue
nodes.summary: View for creating and editing client profiles, covering both natural persons and companies with the required Italian fiscal fields. Delegates persistence to the clients store and navigates back on success.

nodes.name: ClientListView.vue
nodes.summary: Paginated, searchable list of clients with inline deletion via a confirm modal. Uses the clients store for data access and router navigation for create/edit actions.

nodes.name: InvoiceDetailView.vue
nodes.summary: Read-only detail view for a single invoice showing line items, totals, and Italian tax fields, with controls to mark the invoice as paid or delete it. Renders a status badge and links to the print view.

nodes.name: InvoiceFormView.vue
nodes.summary: Create/edit form for invoices with dynamic line-item management, service pre-fill, and live Italian tax computation (IVA, ENPAP, ritenuta, marca da bollo). Reads config and client/service stores to populate defaults.

nodes.name: InvoiceListView.vue
nodes.summary: Searchable, filterable invoice list with multi-select bulk status updates and per-row delete. Uses the invoices store for paginated queries and a confirm modal to guard destructive actions.

nodes.name: InvoicePrintView.vue
nodes.summary: Print/PDF-ready rendering of an invoice following Italian tax document requirements, including regime-specific legal notices, ENPAP surcharge, ritenuta d'acconto, and marca da bollo. Triggers the native OS print dialog via a Tauri IPC call.

nodes.name: MonthlyInvoiceView.vue
nodes.summary: Batch invoicing view that previews completed appointments for a selected month, lets the user toggle client inclusion, and generates invoices in bulk via the API. Navigates to InvoiceListView on completion.

nodes.name: ServiceListView.vue
nodes.summary: Inline CRUD view for professional services (name, unit price, VAT rate) with an embedded create/edit modal and confirm-before-delete behaviour. Backed by the services Pinia store.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite build configuration for the Tauri + Vue 3 frontend: registers the Vue and Tailwind CSS plugins, defines the '@/' path alias pointing to 'src/', and configures the dev server for Tauri's HMR requirements.

nodes.name: generateRecurringDates
nodes.summary: Computes a list of future appointment dates from a start date by filtering weekdays matching the selected recurring-day bitmask.

nodes.name: onSubmit
nodes.summary: Validates and submits the appointment form, branching between single and recurring creation paths, and emitting a save event on success.

nodes.name: onDelete
nodes.summary: Deletes an appointment (or all in its recurrence group) via the API and emits a save event to refresh the parent view.

nodes.name: toggleRecurringDay
nodes.summary: Toggles a day-of-week in the recurring days selection set for scheduling recurring appointments.

nodes.name: onSubmit
nodes.summary: Persists the client form by dispatching a create or update action on the clients store, then navigates back to the client list.

nodes.name: handleDelete
nodes.summary: Deletes the confirmed client via the store and clears the pending delete state.

nodes.name: markAsPaid
nodes.summary: Prompts the user for a payment method and date, then updates the invoice status to 'paid' via the invoices store.

nodes.name: onSubmit
nodes.summary: Validates and submits the invoice form, dispatching create or update through the invoices store, then navigates to the invoice detail on success.

nodes.name: executeBulkUpdate
nodes.summary: Applies the pending bulk status change to all selected invoices via the store and reloads the invoice list.

nodes.name: handlePrint
nodes.summary: Invokes the Tauri 'print_current_page' command to open the native OS print dialog for PDF export.

nodes.name: generate
nodes.summary: Submits the batch invoice generation request for the selected clients and month, then navigates to the invoice list on success.

nodes.name: loadPreview
nodes.summary: Fetches a preview of appointments eligible for batch invoicing for the currently selected month via the API.

nodes.name: saveService
nodes.summary: Persists a new or updated service record through the services store and closes the inline modal.

layers.name: Tauri Command Layer
layers.description: Thin Rust async functions decorated with #[tauri::command] that expose backend operations to the Vue frontend via Tauri IPC. Includes controller mod declarations.

layers.name: Business Logic Layer
layers.description: Rust service modules containing domain orchestration, business rules, and use-case logic. Coordinates between controllers and repositories without exposing persistence details.

layers.name: Data Access Layer
layers.description: Rust repository implementations, SeaORM entity definitions, database connection management, and schema migrations. Abstracts all SQLite persistence behind repository interfaces.

layers.name: Domain Models Layer
layers.description: Rust DTOs and request/response model structs used across the backend (model/), plus the TypeScript types.ts defining shared data contracts for the Vue frontend.

layers.name: Vue UI Layer
layers.description: Vue 3 views and reusable UI components that render the application interface, handle user interactions, and compose the visual presentation using Tailwind CSS.

layers.name: Frontend State & Config
layers.description: Pinia stores managing client-side application state, Vue Router for navigation, api.ts as the Tauri IPC bridge, utility helpers, and Vite build configuration.

layers.name: Tauri Bootstrap & Infrastructure
layers.description: Rust application entry points and wiring: lib.rs registers all Tauri commands and initializes the app, main.rs launches it, build.rs generates platform glue, and app/mod.rs stitches sub-modules together.

tour.title: Frontend Entry Point
tour.description: The Vue 3 application boots here. `main.ts` creates the app instance, registers global plugins (Pinia for state, Vue Router for navigation), and mounts the root component onto the DOM. This is the single seam where every frontend dependency is wired together before any UI renders.

tour.title: Shared Domain Types
tour.description: With 15 files importing it, `types.ts` is the highest fan-in file in the entire frontend. It defines every domain concept the UI knows about — `Invoice`, `Client`, `Appointment`, `TaxRate` and more — as TypeScript interfaces. Keeping all contracts in one place enforces a single source of truth and prevents the frontend from inventing its own shadow models.
tour.languageLesson: TypeScript interfaces as a contract layer — analogous to DTOs in the backend

tour.title: Router and View Hierarchy
tour.description: `router/index.ts` maps URL paths to Vue view components, effectively defining every user-reachable screen. `App.vue` is the shell that hosts the `<RouterView>` outlet. Together they establish the navigation contract: every feature is a route, every route is a view component.

tour.title: Pinia State Stores
tour.description: The three domain stores — `invoices.ts`, `clients.ts`, and `config.ts` — are the frontend's application layer. Each store owns one slice of domain state and exposes actions that call the API bridge. Views stay thin by delegating all data-fetching and mutation to these stores, keeping business-relevant orchestration out of the templates.
tour.languageLesson: Pinia stores mirror the Application Service layer from DDD — they orchestrate but hold no domain logic

tour.title: Tauri API Bridge
tour.description: `api.ts` is the boundary between the Vue world and the Rust backend. Every function wraps a `invoke()` call to a named Tauri command, translating JavaScript promises into typed responses. It is the Anti-Corruption Layer of the frontend: 17 files depend on it, but it itself has zero runtime dependencies — it only speaks the Tauri IPC protocol.
tour.languageLesson: Anti-Corruption Layer pattern: the bridge normalises an external protocol so the rest of the app never sees raw IPC

tour.title: Rust Entry Point and Command Registration
tour.description: `lib.rs` is where the Tauri application is constructed on the Rust side. It initialises the SQLite connection pool, runs pending migrations, and registers every `#[tauri::command]` handler so the IPC dispatcher knows which Rust function to call for each command name. `main.rs` simply delegates to `lib.rs` — the real wiring lives here.
tour.languageLesson: Rust / Tauri 2 — command registration is the runtime equivalent of dependency injection in the backend

tour.title: Controller Layer — Thin Tauri Commands
tour.description: `invoice_controller.rs` exposes each Tauri command as a thin async function. With a fan-out of 16, it delegates immediately to `invoice_service.rs` without adding logic of its own, keeping the transport layer (Tauri IPC) separate from the business layer. This is the Presentation layer in the layered architecture — it deserialises inputs and serialises outputs.
tour.languageLesson: Controllers should be embarrassingly thin — if business logic creeps in here, it becomes untestable

tour.title: Service Layer — Business Logic
tour.description: `invoice_service.rs` is the Application Service for invoicing. It orchestrates the full lifecycle of an invoice: validation, tax calculation (delegating to `tax_service.rs`), and persistence (delegating to `invoice_repository.rs`). With a fan-out of 16, it touches every collaborator it needs, but it owns no I/O itself — making it the easiest layer to unit-test.
tour.languageLesson: Application Services orchestrate; they do not implement. Business rules live here, I/O does not.

tour.title: Tax Calculation — Dual Implementation
tour.description: Tax calculation is implemented twice: in Rust (`tax_service.rs`) for server-side accuracy during invoice creation and persistence, and in TypeScript (`src/utils/tax.ts`) for instant client-side feedback while the psychologist fills in the form. Both implementations must agree on the Italian withholding-tax rules. This dual-implementation pattern is a deliberate trade-off between UX responsiveness and authoritative backend computation.
tour.languageLesson: When performance matters at the UI layer, duplicating pure calculation logic is acceptable — but both sides must be tested against the same golden values

tour.title: Repository Layer — Data Access
tour.description: `invoice_repository.rs` is the only layer that speaks SQL. It translates domain operations (find, save, update status) into SeaORM queries and returns domain model structs. The service layer depends on a repository trait, not this concrete struct, so the database implementation can change without touching business logic.
tour.languageLesson: Repository Pattern — domain logic never constructs queries; it asks a repository to do it

tour.title: Entity and DTO Layer
tour.description: `entity/invoice.rs` is the SeaORM-generated struct that maps directly to the `invoices` database table — it is a persistence model, not a domain model. `model/invoice.rs` is the DTO that crosses the Tauri IPC boundary, shaped for serialisation. Keeping these three representations (entity, model, domain struct) separate prevents the database schema from leaking into the API contract.
tour.languageLesson: Three distinct representations: ORM entity (DB shape), domain struct (business shape), DTO (transport shape)

tour.title: Database Bootstrap and Migrations
tour.description: `connection.rs` sets up the SQLite connection pool as a singleton injected into the Tauri state. The two migration files tell the full schema story chronologically: `m20240101_create_schema.rs` establishes the initial tables for clients, appointments, and invoices; `m20240201_add_batch_invoicing.rs` adds the columns needed for batch (monthly) invoicing. Reading migrations in order is the fastest way to understand how the data model evolved.
tour.languageLesson: Migrations are executable documentation — they record every deliberate schema decision in chronological order

tour.title: Invoice UI — List and Form
tour.description: `InvoiceListView.vue` is the main screen a psychologist uses daily: it renders all invoices, supports filtering, and triggers status changes. `InvoiceFormView.vue` is the creation and editing form, wiring the tax utility to give real-time cost breakdowns before the user saves. These views illustrate how thin the presentation layer is: they read from the Pinia store and call store actions — no direct API calls.

tour.title: Batch Invoicing Feature
tour.description: `MonthlyInvoiceView.vue` is the capstone feature: a psychologist selects a month and the system generates one invoice per client based on appointment records. The full vertical slice runs through `api.ts` → `invoice_controller.rs` → `invoice_service.rs` (the `generate_monthly` command) → `invoice_repository.rs` → the schema columns added in the second migration. This feature demonstrates how every architectural layer participates in a single user workflow.
tour.languageLesson: A vertical slice exercise: trace one user action from button click to database write and back to the UI
